## Maintainer ruling recorded — **adopted: repo classes, with the two non-negotiable carve-outs**

Provenance: maintainer, 2026-08-26, live PM chat (decision-inbox batch 1 review, session `session_01JANH3y7qe3MD8aLaLXci8N`), verbatim: 「其他同意」 — accepting this card's presented recommendation: adopt the repo-class model. Binding conditions, exactly as presented and accepted:

1. **代裁 (decision-card adjudication) and the cross-repo dedupe/shadow check stay with the central triage seat in BOTH classes** — non-negotiable; if implementation cannot keep 代裁 out of execution seats, the proposal is rejected whole, not executed at a discount.
2. Single-lane repos (`cloud`, `objectos`, `hotcrm`, `www.objectos.ai`, and future repos by default) become **self-triaging** for the conflict-free mechanical duties only: own sweep, own `type`, own `finding` first-touch grading; they produce no `domain:*`.
3. Registration becomes a **checklist** (seat post, labels, class assignment, gate inventory) with an admission criterion: does this repo genuinely need a standing seat. Repo #7 walks the checklist, not a decision card.
4. Single-lane repos' decision cards queue in the **objectstack inbox by default** (维护者收件箱恒为 objectstack) — settled here as the implementation answer to the card's own weakest point.

State: `needs-user-decision` → **`pm:queue`** (skills-lane implementation work: the pm-dispatch SKILL.md multi-repo section rewrite — clause ① mandated tier, line ratchet applies, the five-repo enumeration and the 代扫 exception text are the named compression candidates). ⚠️ Serial: the SKILL.md main file is held by PR #12406 (awaiting human merge); this card queues behind it.

## Ruling amended — returned to the decision box for one aspect

Provenance: maintainer, 2026-08-26, live PM chat, verbatim: 「12227 可以再讨论一下,skills 和决裁的问题,还是由skills席统一人工处理,我会要求你处理某个仓的skills 和决裁。」

What stands from the earlier acceptance: the repo-class model itself (single-lane repos self-triage the conflict-free mechanical duties; registration by checklist with the standing-seat admission criterion). What is reopened and being re-discussed in chat: **where 决裁 (decision-card processing) and cross-repo skills work sit** — the maintainer's direction is that BOTH are handled uniformly by the **skills seat** in the maintainer-driven human flow (「我会要求你处理某个仓的 skills 和决裁」), rather than reserved to the central triage seat as previously recorded. The refined shape (including what happens to the triage seat's auto-adjudication channel) is being settled in the live discussion; the implementing dispatch waits for it.

State: `pm:queue` → **`needs-user-decision`** in the same stroke — a card whose scope is being re-discussed must not sit in a dispatchable queue.

## Final ruling recorded — repo classes ADOPTED, with the amended governance split

Provenance: maintainer, 2026-08-26, live PM chat, two strokes — 「12227 可以再讨论一下,skills 和决裁的问题,还是由skills席统一人工处理,我会要求你处理某个仓的skills 和决裁。」 then, settling the reopened sub-question, verbatim: 「代裁通道如果是 fable 可以代裁,其他接受你的建议」.

The implementing scope, complete:

1. **Repo classes** (as originally accepted): multi-lane repos (`objectstack`, `objectui`) keep central triage as sole producer of `domain:*`/type/grading; **single-lane repos** (`cloud`, `objectos`, `hotcrm`, `www.objectos.ai`, future repos by default) are **self-triaging for the conflict-free mechanical duties** — own sweep, own `type`, own `finding` first-touch grading; they produce no `domain:*`.
2. **Registration is a checklist** (seat post, labels, class assignment, gate inventory) with the admission criterion: does this repo genuinely need a standing seat.
3. **决裁 (decision-card processing) and cross-repo skills/instruction-surface work: uniformly the skills seat's, in the maintainer-driven human flow** (「我会要求你处理某个仓的 skills 和决裁」) — batched presentation, four-axis analysis, post-ruling atomic execution.
4. **The auto-adjudication channel (代裁) is RETAINED, hard-gated on tier**: a session may auto-adjudicate only when its measured serving model equals the contract-review tier (`claude-fable-5`, machine-read via the downgrade fuse — never self-description). All other confidence-gate conditions of the 2026-08-12 ruling stand unchanged (四棱同向, not on the manual floor, no narrowing of prior rulings, veto-window execution, auto-adjudicated ledger in the round report). The fable-tier condition applies to whichever seat runs the channel — the triage Routine at its pinned tier, or the skills seat.
5. **Cross-repo dedupe / shadow check stays central** (the all-repo view cannot be devolved).
6. Single-lane repos' decision cards queue in the **objectstack inbox** by default.

State: `needs-user-decision` → **`pm:queue`**. Implementation = the pm-dispatch SKILL.md multi-repo/governance section rewrite (clause-① mandated tier; line ratchet applies; the five-repo enumeration and the 代扫 exception text are the named compression candidates). ⚠️ Serial: the SKILL.md main file frees when PR #12406 reaches MERGED; this card queues at the head of that file's line.

Ratchet readings (live, this tree): `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 1005/1005 — at ceiling: every added line must be paid for by a same-file cut, with cut-ledger rows naming the surviving home of anything removed; `references/decision-analysis.md` 46/46 — same discipline. ⛔ no re-wrap to smuggle lines.
Member #12434 routing — maintainer direct-dispatch channel (standing authorization 2026-08-05/10 line; the card was filed today and triage has not yet labeled it). Authorizing instruction quoted verbatim (maintainer, 2026-08-26, this session): 「skills 中的pr，只有包含md文件时需要推给我审核，其他代码文件你直接自己审核。决裁流程今天这样很好，决策卡5张一组，从业务的角度给我具体解释，说明可选项，并进行四维分析。应该写入技能。」 — the closing sentence is the write-into-the-skill order this dispatch executes; the first sentence is itself one of the two rulings being codified.
Review path: the PR will contain .md files, so per that same ruling it lands as a **draft for maintainer review** (governed surface, human merge — the new code-only self-review fork does not apply here).

- Both 2026-08-26 rulings codified with verbatim quotes; the md-content review fork is correctly bounded to the skills lane's own PRs, and the Guardrails governed-merge bullet cross-references it instead of contradicting it.
- Compression drawn from exactly the ruling-named candidates; cut ledger names a surviving home per row; ratchet verdict 1004/1005 + 46/46, ceilings untouched; no issue numbers or bracket placeholders in operational text.
